# ezghcloud_cdn_distribution (Data Source)

A CDN distribution, by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Distribution ID (cdn_).
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier.

### Read-Only

- `default_hostname` (String) d<12>.ezghcdn.com: the CNAME target of its domains.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `domain` (Attributes List) Its own domains. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domain))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it serves its hostnames.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `origin` (Attributes) Where requests go. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origin))
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `status` (String) deploying or deployed.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.
